landing.title: Know your rights. Draft with confidence. Track your case.
landing.subtitle: LawTrack explains Indian law in clear English and Hindi, helps you prepare complaints and RTI applications, and keeps your court dates in one place — with a curator-verified knowledge base behind every answer.
landing.primaryFeatureBody: Every guide is checked by a legal curator and cites the Act and section it comes from.
landing.draftFeatureBody: Answer simple questions to prepare a complaint, RTI application or legal notice. A lawyer reviews it before you share it.
landing.trackFeatureBody: Look up your CNR number to see the next hearing date and plain-language summaries of court orders.
landing.stepOneBody: Put your question in everyday English or Hindi. No legal vocabulary needed.
landing.stepTwoBody: Each answer points to the validated guides it came from, so you can check the law yourself.
landing.stepThreeBody: Prepare a draft for a lawyer to review, or track a case by CNR number.
landing.trustBody: LawTrack is an independent prototype. It is not a government service, it does not predict outcomes, and it always points you to a lawyer for complex matters.
landing.demoNote: Demo build only. Every account uses the password {{password}}. These accounts are never seeded in production.

curator.loadError: We could not load the guide.

drafts.title: Your drafts
drafts.intro: Create a complaint, an RTI application or a legal notice. Every draft is reviewed by a legal-aid lawyer before it is final.
drafts.createIntro: Answer a few questions. The draft is generated only from the facts you provide.
drafts.typeComplaintBody: Report a problem to an authority, a shop, a landlord or an employer.
drafts.typeRtiBody: Ask a public authority for information under the RTI Act, 2005.
drafts.typeLegalNoticeBody: Formally demand action from a person or business before taking legal steps.
drafts.answersIntro: Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
drafts.reviewIntro: Compare the citizen's answers with the generated text before deciding.

cases.title: Track a court case
cases.intro: Enter the 16-character CNR number printed on your court papers to see the case status, the next hearing date and a plain-English summary of past orders. This demo reads example records, not live court data.
cases.lookupHint: Four letters followed by twelve digits, for example RJJP010012342022.
cases.invalidCnr: Enter a CNR of 4 letters and 12 digits.
cases.notFoundTitle: No case found for that CNR
cases.notFoundBody: No court record matched that CNR number. Check the number printed on your papers and try again.
cases.unavailableTitle: The court service is not responding
cases.unavailableBody: We could not reach the case service just now. Your tracked cases below are unchanged; please try again in a few minutes.
cases.failedTitle: We could not look up that case
cases.trackedEmptyBody: Look up a CNR above and it will appear here with every hearing date.
cases.noNextDate: Next date not yet listed by the court
cases.staleBannerBody: The court service could not be reached, so this is the information we stored earlier. It may be out of date.
cases.hearingsEmpty: The court has not published any hearings for this case yet.
cases.orderNone: No written order was published for this hearing.
cases.refreshFailed: The court service could not be reached. Showing the last saved copy.
cases.dashboardEmptyBody: Track a case by CNR to see hearing dates here.
cases.overdueNotice: The next date has passed — the court has not listed a new one yet.
